redaction_notes: Expose runtime identifiers and bounded status summaries only.
Do not expose concrete world content, private fixture paths, or event payloads.
Expose event type counts and summarized event labels only.
Do not expose raw external event payloads or private transcripts.
Expose bounded perception, action, and result summaries only.
Do not expose prompts, private traces, provider secrets, or hidden runner hooks.
Expose bounded memory summaries and public context references only.
Do not expose raw memory records, private transcripts, or prompt traces.
Expose readiness status and compatibility summaries only.
Do not expose seed data, maps, story rules, character names, or location names.
Expose public manifest identifiers and public readiness taxonomy only.
Do not turn taxonomy values into unverified PASS claims.
Expose redacted report identifiers, outcome status, and finding counts only.
Do not expose concrete fixture data, UI selectors, or oracle internals.

redaction_rules: Expose only public identifiers, public references, statuses, counts, ranges, claims, and bounded summaries.
Do not expose concrete validation worlds, maps, locations, character names, story rules, seed data, or private fixture paths.
Do not expose UI selectors, provider secrets, prompts, private traces, transcripts, raw memory records, or non-redacted event payloads.
Do not use this contract to claim projection application readiness, product readiness, external consumer PASS, runtime/API/frontend PASS, or v0.8 readiness.
compatibility_notes: This contract is additive and read-only.
Existing runtime, API, frontend, Agent loop, memory, generation, event, persistence, and backend/worldengine behavior are unchanged.
API-backed projection surfaces require a later reviewed package.
The readiness manifest from 0.7.3 remains valid without modification.
